name: Manager Valuation Memorandum
description: A document providing an independent valuation of a real estate asset, outlining methodology, key assumptions, and appraised value.
key_questions: What is the name of the property being valued?
What valuation methodology was used (e.g., DCF)?
What is the appraised capitalization value?
What are the key valuation assumptions (e.g., base discount rate, terminal cap rate, holding period)?
What is the resulting Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio for the asset?
